title: Yikes! Crewneck
description: A Bone crewneck with a standard, full-length fit and a yellow-and-blue YIKES! chest print. The 8.5 oz fleece uses an 80% cotton, 20% polyester blend with a smooth cotton face. Ribbing finishes the collar, cuffs and waistband, with double-needle seams and twill neck tape.
measurementGuidance: Compare these measurements with a garment you already own. Body length is measured from the high point of the shoulder; chest width is measured flat 1 inch below the armhole.
